response.original_title: 義母の秘密 覗いてしまった淫行
response.overview: Mizuki and Yoichi are half-siblings. As they reach adolescence, Yoichi begins to see Mizuki as a woman, and his sexual desire for his sister grows ever stronger. Meanwhile, Mizuki, unaware of Yoichi’s feelings, exchanges marriage vows with her boyfriend, Keisuke. Then, a certain incident occurs…
response.title: 義母の秘密 覗いてしまった淫行
